featured_reviews.name: Manan Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I booked Honeybook Studio for my pre-wedding shoot after seeing their polished Instagram and Google reviews. I paid Rs. 20,000 for a full-day shoot (originally a Rs. 25,000 plan), and also spent Rs. 1,200 for lunch. I was genuinely excited and had high expectations – but everything went downhill the moment we arrived.

The studio was in terrible condition. Walls were peeling, paint was faded, and the sets looked completely artificial and neglected. Many props were broken, lights didn’t work, and it felt like the place had been left untouched since its launch. Our mood was ruined from the start, especially after traveling 4–5 hours just to reach there.

The staff behavior was unprofessional. We had pre-booked breakfast, but by the time we arrived, most items were cold or finished. On top of all this, the studio is located in a remote village area with very poor mobile network – which made things worse when we needed to coordinate.

My honest advice: don’t fall for their staged photos or promo videos. Unless they renovate and maintain their sets, this place is just not worth the money or effort. You’d be better off choosing a well-maintained public spot for a free or budget-friendly shoot.

Although, Some sets were good but most of not so I Highly recommended to not visit
